# Historical native build evidence

Precompiled screensaver packages are no longer distributed. Build Windows,
macOS, or Linux locally using the [source build guide](../README.md#ports).
Local build products in this directory are ignored by Git.

`BUILD_INFO.json`, `SHA256SUMS`, and `verification/` describe the earlier
native 1.1 packages withdrawn on 7 September 2026. Preserve these records as
historical evidence; their hashes do not certify a newly compiled local build.
The source history is retained without rewriting release tags.
